name: Lingyuan ~Hua Mi Jie Zhou, Yuan Ying Jiao Zhi~
original_name: 靈緣 ～化謎解咒，緣影交織～
source: “Person of Serendipity… please help us——” A text-based adventure puzzle game set in ancient villages, where shrine maidens and the Kami guide you to forge unbreakable bonds. Every choice reshapes destiny—you will lead them, but to where?
